item.text:
The audit now has 17 confirmed findings. This pass added a storage-contract failure: after trimming, `MemoryStorage::get_entries(0, 2)` and `get_suffix(0)` panic with subtraction overflow instead of returning the documented empty vector. Reproduction is included in `audit_runner` and logged in [repro_core_checks.log](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/repro_core_checks.log).

The persistent-storage finding was also strengthened:

- `append_entries` has the same stale-`next_log_key` corruption as `write_atomically`.
- A failed transaction that includes one valid append can be committed by a later unrelated write.
- The leaked entry remains visible after closing and reopening RocksDB, confirming durable state corruption.

Default workspace compilation and all-feature runtime tests remain clean. The complete report and all reproduction files are available at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
